payload.title: Dashboard builds only on one machine and has no CI
payload.description:
Found while fixing dashboard npm alerts (blbs-9459a5, PR 93). apps/dashboard cannot be installed, built or tested on a fresh checkout:
- package.json line 64 declares springstack as a file: dependency on an absolute path inside one developer's home directory, so it resolves on no other machine.
- npm ci fails on develop because package-lock.json is out of sync with package.json.
- tsc --noEmit reports 14 errors (missing springstack module, missing amplify_outputs.json, import.meta.env types, react-resizable-panels prop types).
- npm test cannot start: cucumber.js is CommonJS in an ES-module package, and the scenarios need a running app plus Playwright.
- No CI job runs anything for the dashboard, so dependency updates (such as PR 93's Amplify backend 1.22 to 1.25 and react-router-dom 6.30.6) ship unverified.
Fix: depend on springstack through a published package or a git dependency (decide with Ryan which), make npm ci pass, fix the typecheck errors, make the cucumber suite runnable, and add a dashboard CI job (npm ci, typecheck, build, tests) required on develop and main. Blocks the next develop-to-main release while PR 93's updates are on develop.
